title: Part 13: how expert subagents are run and recorded
context: No expert or chief agent definition exists; the expert skills run inline. There is no SubagentStart hook (paqad-hooks.ts). The existing SubagentStop matcher '^(paqad:)?paqad-' already fires for any paqad-* agent, and stageFromAgentType (subagent-completion.ts:47) wrongly turns it into a stage-agent row. writeExpertNotes (run-store.ts:496) replaces all findings and tokens per call. Token counts today read the parent transcript, not the subagent's (transcript.mjs:48).

options.label: Two new agent definitions (paqad-expert, given its role in the prompt, and paqad-chief-architect) beside the stage agents; a new bundle ledger high-table.jsonl gets a 'writing' row when the seat's subagent runs 'experts brief <role>' and a 'done' row when 'experts notes' lands (merged per role, under a file lock so parallel seats never lose a note); the existing SubagentStop hook, unchanged in matcher and order, routes non-stage paqad agents to a token row read from the subagent's own transcript (exact) and never writes a stage-agent row. No new hook.
